independent.summary: The rollback cannot be retried by "the next hourly tick" as the code comment and item claim: the only caller is cron.schedule('0 * * * *') (leoRefresh.js:306), one tick per hour, and weeklyDigestDecision requires an exact UTC day+hour slot match — so an hour after a rolled-back slot-match send, elapsed (~7d+1h) is off-schedule and still inside CATCHUP_MS (8d), giving no retry until ~23h later via the catch-up arm; worse, for a never-sent entity (previousStamp null) the first-run arm returns early for last===null and the catch-up arm can never apply, so the released claim buys nothing and the first digest is still lost for the whole week — the exact failure the item set out to fix.

Both retry tests only pass because they stay inside the same cron hour while claiming otherwise: line 785 is commented "An hourly tick an hour later" but uses MONDAY_13 + 60 * 1000 (one minute), and the never-sent test at 791 asserts weeklyDigestDue(...) === true at MONDAY_13 + 60 * 1000 with the comment "the first-run arm, not the gap guard, is what the retry meets" — with a real hourly offset (MONDAY_13 + HOUR) the first returns 0 sends and the second returns false, so neither test exercises the retry the production scheduler would actually produce.
